big: India's defence exports hit a record ₹38,424 crore in FY26, up 62.7% from ₹23,622 crore. India now sells to more than 100 countries. A buyer of jets and ships became a seller too.

lines: Yes. Exports jumped 62.7% in a year. DPSUs gave about 55% and private firms about 45%. Buyers include the US, France and Armenia. The target is ₹50,000 crore by 2029.
